answer: Physical Embodiment Audit. Each identity must periodically pass a remote check that combines a live structured-light depth scan of its operator with a synchronized inertial trace, matched against a stored biometric template; a fable of a recorded video fails because depth and motion cannot be replayed together. The check runs from a fixed ocean-floor cable node so latency bounds are tight. An attacker must acquire unique live bodies and physical presence per identity. Storing a cedar token proves nothing; the operator must appear.
